data.fund_type: An open ended scheme replicating/tracking Nifty 50 Index
data.investment_objective: The main investment objective of the fund is to generate returns commensurate with the performance of the index Nifty based on the plans by investing in the respective index stocks subject to tracking errors. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity / Equity Futures (in Nifty 50): 95-100%, Money market instruments and cash: 0-5%. Please refer the Scheme Information Document for complete details.
data.exit_load: 0.25% if redeemed or switch out on or before completion of 7 Days from the date of allotment of units, Nil after 7 days
